Around 400,000 years after the Big Bang , the fledgling universe finally cooled enough to form atoms — mostly hydrogen.

curiosity.title: Can animals lie? This sneaky bird might be proof.

These are adaptations shaped by natural selection over countless generations, not conscious choices.
